messages.subject: Project Tempest - Amendment & Restatement Agreement (first draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair, Nadia,

Please find our first draft of the Amendment and Restatement Agreement, drafted to the agreed term sheet. It amends and restates the 2022 SFA, documents the £8m super-senior tranche and the £4m shareholder contribution, and carries the reset covenant schedule and the conditions precedent.

A couple of points still open on our side: the precise excess-cashflow definition and the cure mechanics in clause 8.5. Look forward to your comments.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Tempest - Amendment & Restatement Agreement (first draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached. Headline points: super-senior confirmed at £8m (up from the £6m placeholder in your draft); Facility A maturity to 30 June 2028; Facility A margin to 4.75%; amendment fee to 0.50%; minimum liquidity to £2.5m; the excess cashflow sweep to 50%; and we've added the 2.00% PIK on the super-senior. We've accepted two cures per year.

If the client is content we can move to execution version next week.

Alistair

Alistair Whitlock | Partner | Pemberton Rowe LLP
